mapper.select: SELECT cr.room_id, cr.project_id, cr.is_active, cr.last_message_at, u.name, u.profile_image_url, m.content AS last_message_content, m.sender_id AS last_message_sender_id, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m3 WHERE m3.room_id = cr.room_id AND m3.sender_id != #{member_id} AND m3.is_read = 0 ) AS unread_count FROM chat_rooms cr JOIN users u ON u.user_id = cr.freelancer_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m2.* FROM messages m2 WHERE m2.room_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m2.created_at DESC ) m ON m.room_id = cr.room_id AND m.message_id = ( SELECT m3.message_id FROM messages m3 WHERE m3.room_id = cr.room_id ORDER BY m3.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE cr.freelancer_id = #{member_id} ORDER BY cr.last_message_at DESC
SELECT cr.room_id, cr.last_message_at, cr.last_message_content, u.name, u.profile_image_url FROM chat_rooms cr JOIN users u ON u.user_id = cr.freelancer_id WHERE cr.room_id = #{room_id}
